text: Work on main only — no feature branches
Read DEFERRED.md at session start
Never set FORCE_SYNC=true
Never commit .env files or seed data with real PII
All routes prefixed /api/
All frontend HTTP via shared/services/api.js
ES Modules only in backend — no require()
Sequelize migrations only — never sync schema in production
New controllers MUST ship with tests
Error-path fixes MUST include a test that triggers the failure
ALL catch branches must return error-appropriate status codes
Response shape {success,data} / {success,error:{code,detail}}
Any PR introducing a new error code MUST add a catalog row
Defense-in-depth role checks at route AND controller
Child-scoped resources MUST call validateChildAccess
Never call AuditLog.create() directly from controllers
audit_log is append-only (3 layers)
Destroy on paranoid models passes {actorId, actorRole, reason}
Bulk import two-phase, per-row atomicity
PascalCase components, camelCase services/utils
Conventional commits
Pre-commit: Husky -> lint-staged -> ESLint
Run full suite before any PR
Frontend: CI fails if no test files in an app
i18n verify: all catalog codes in every language file
